purpose: Debt ledger of deliberate ponytail shortcuts: greps every `shortcut:` (or legacy `ponytail:`) comment into a tracked list with its ceiling and upgrade trigger. One-shot report, changes nothing.
use_when: Listing every deferred shortcut marker as a debt ledger
Asking what ponytail deferred or which shortcuts lack an upgrade trigger
Harvesting shortcut: comments into a tracked file
do_not_use_when: A general quality review or audit (use ponytail-review or ponytail-audit)
scope: Greps markers and reports; changes nothing unless asked to persist the ledger.
disambiguator: Counting deferred shortcut markers -> this. Anything else in the ponytail family -> see disambiguators there.
